name: How to Choose the Right Engineered Wood
subtitle: 8 Types for Every Project
description: Choosing the right wood board can make or break your project. Literally. Engineered boards like plywood, MDF, and particle board may look similar in the store, but they behave very differently when you start cutting, screwing, or finishing them. This guide breaks down eight common types of engineered wood with real-world pros, cons, cost, and ease of use. Whether you're a DIY beginner or seasoned woodworker, you'll know exactly what to pick for your next project.

name: Common Electrical Disasters
subtitle: A Minimalist's Guide to Electrical Wiring
description: Electrical issues like melting plugs and tripping breakers often start small but can lead to serious hazards. This simple, beginner-friendly guide explains common wiring mistakes and how to prevent them using practical tips for a safer home setup.
